extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, park visitors, and the general public seeking National Park Service news and media resources
extracted.subtask_description: The National Park Service central news landing page that aggregates NPS news releases, multimedia, facts & figures, publications, and media contact information for parks and NPS programs across the United States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official website authenticity (.gov)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A .gov website belongs to an official government organization in the United States. This indicator can be used to verify that information is from an official source.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secure connection (HTTPS)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A lock ( ) or https:// means you've safely connected to the .gov website. Share sensitive information only on official, secure websites.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Releases access and filtering
rubrics_metrics.description: Here you can view all National Park Service news releases, search by topic, or filter by park or office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the site search and filtering to locate specific NPS news releases by topic, park, or office when researching or citing NPS statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: DOI (parent agency) news releases
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Our parent agency, the U.S. Department of the Interior, publishes news releases relating to national parks and other natural and cultural resource topics; consult DOI releases for additional or broader coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fire news category
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fire-related incidents and updates are grouped in a distinct category; consult this category for wildfire- and fire-management-related news.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media as a news channel
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gain a deeper understanding of national parks and discover important news and events from more than 400 parks and NPS programs on the NPS social media channels; use these channels for timely updates and outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia searchability
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the multimedia search to find photos, audio files, and video presentations by keyword, location, or file type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search multimedia by keywords, location, or file type when sourcing images or audio/video for press use or research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photos & Multimedia and commercial filming/photography guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: See Photos & Multimedia for additional sources of multimedia content and to learn about commercial filming and photo permits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the Photos & Multimedia resources to locate additional media assets and to understand requirements and processes (permits) for commercial filming and photography on NPS lands.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facts & Figures for authoritative statistics
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Facts & Figures pages to access quick facts or detailed information about the National Park Service, including most-visited parks, anniversaries, designations, and other statistics useful for reporting or background.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publications as official documentation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The National Park Service explains decisions, documents information, and shares knowledge through a variety of publications, many of which are available online; use these publications for authoritative background and policy details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact Media Staff for press inquiries
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Find contact information for media relations staff to direct press inquiries, request interviews, or obtain official statements from specific parks or NPS offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan Your Visit / event information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: National parks host events year-round; consult 'Plan Your Visit' pages to learn about park-specific events, visitor information, and programs that may be newsworthy or relevant to coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page currency (last updated)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the page's 'last updated' date to confirm the currency of the information before relying on it for reporting or citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Site policies and legal notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Accessibility; Privacy Policy; FOIA; Notices; Contact The National Park Service; NPS FAQ; No Fear Act; Disclaimer; Vulnerability Disclosure Policy; USA.gov
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These links point to legal, accessibility, privacy, and administrative policies relevant to how information is published and used on the site; consult them for legal/privacy/FOIA procedures or to understand site terms.
